changes.title: Mahindra Rivenza
changes.note: Facts from Mahindra Lifespaces' own launch release

ops.value: Mahindra Rivenza is a residential project by Mahindra Lifespaces in Baner Annex, Mahalunge, Pune, on a 13.46-acre site. Phase 1 has 1,236 homes in 2, 3 and 4 BHK configurations, with a 44,000+ sq ft clubhouse and more than 9 acres of landscaped green spaces. The project is IGBC pre-certified Gold and planned as a net-zero-waste development.

ops.label: Amenities
ops.value: Clubhouse (44,000+ sq ft), 9+ acres of landscaped greens, swimming pool with sunken bar, gymnasium, badminton court, squash court, pickleball court, cycling and jogging tracks, glass-roof library, children's play area, giant swings, stargazing hammocks
